identificationModule.briefTitle: Long Term Treatment of Patients With Major Depressive Disorder With MK0869 (0869-065)(COMPLETED)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Multicenter Study of the Long-Term Efficacy of MK0869 in the Maintenance of Antidepressant Effect in Patients With Major Depressive Disorder

descriptionModule.briefSummary: A clinical study to determine the efficacy and safety of an investigational medication (MK0869) in the treatment of depression.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: The duration of treatment is 20 months.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Total HAMD-17 score </= 10 after 10 weeks of treatment, time to relapse of depression over 6-10 months
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: after 10 weeks of treatment and over 6-10 months

secondaryOutcomes.measure: CGI-S score change from Week 10 at Month 6; HAMD-17 total score change from Week 10 at Month 6; an HAMA total score change from week 10 at Month 6.
